SCRIPT:
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Year': [2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022],
    'East Africa': [12.1, 13.0, 14.3, 15.1, 16.2],
    'West Africa': [15.0, 16.2, 17.8, 18.5, 20.1],
    'Southern Africa': [10.8, 11.7, 12.9, 13.8, 14.8],
    'North Africa': [13.7, 14.6, 15.9, 17.0, 18.2],
    'Central Africa': [9.5, 10.2, 11.3, 12.0, 13.0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.set_index('Year', inplace=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
colors = ['#2c7bb6', '#d7191c', '#fdae61', '#abdda4', '#66c2a5']

for i, region in enumerate(df.columns):
    if region != 'Central Africa':
        plt.plot(df.index, df[region],
                 marker='o',
                 label=region,
                 color=colors[i],
                 linewidth=2.5)

plt.title('Long-Term GDP Growth Projections in European Countries (2018-2022)',
          fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('GDP Growth Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.legend(title='Region', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.xticks(df.index)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')

)
s = s.replace("Long-Term GDP Growth Projections in European Countries (2018-2022)",
              "Short-Term Debt Sustainability Trends in African Regions (2018-2022)")
s = s.replace("plt.ylabel('GDP Growth Rate (%)', fontsize=12)",
              "plt.ylabel('Debt Sustainability Index', fontsize=12)\nplt.ylim(9, 21)")
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gca()
expected = pd.read_csv("table.csv").set_index("Year")
for line in ax.lines:
    region = line.get_label()
    assert list(line.get_xdata()) == list(expected.index)
    assert list(line.get_ydata()) == list(expected[region])
    assert line.get_marker() == 'o'
assert len(ax.lines) == 5
assert ax.get_ylim() == (9, 21)
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Y-axis:", ax.get_ylabel(), ax.get_ylim())
print("Legend:", ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[1])
print("Colors:", [(line.get_label(), line.get_color()) for line in ax.lines])
